title: Computer Running Slow — High CPU & Memory Usage
symptoms: Fan running loud and computer slow
prerequisites: Access to Task Manager or Activity Monitor
diagnostic_questions: Did this slowness start after opening a specific application?
How long has the computer been powered on without a reboot?
Is your hard drive almost full?
Do you hear the fan spinning at maximum speed constantly?

resolution_steps.action: Let's check what's consuming your system resources. Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager. Look at the 'Processes' tab and sort by CPU and Memory. Find any hung apps or browsers with excessive memory usage and click 'End Task'.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did ending high-resource applications improve your computer's speed?

resolution_steps.action: A full system reboot clears accumulated cached memory, memory leaks, and hung background services. Please save your open documents and restart your computer now.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did restarting your computer resolve the slowness?

resolution_steps.action: Let's clear temporary system files. Press Win + R, type 'cleanmgr' and press Enter. Select drive C:, check 'Temporary files' and 'Recycle Bin', then click OK to delete junk files.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did disk cleanup free up space and help your PC?

resolution_steps.action: Check for pending Windows Updates. Go to Start → Settings → Windows Update and install any pending quality or driver updates, then restart.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Are updates installed and is the computer running normally now?

escalation_criteria: If high CPU/memory usage persists across reboots with no user apps running (suspected hardware degradation or system corruption)
